description: PolicyReportSummary provides a status count summary

error.description: Error provides the count of policies that could not be evaluated

fail.description: Fail provides the count of policies whose requirements were not met

pass.description: Pass provides the count of policies whose requirements were met

skip.description: Skip indicates the count of policies that were not selected for evaluation

warn.description: Warn provides the count of non-scored policies whose requirements were not met
